summary: Iteration 2 frontend validation of the 8 fixes from iteration_1. 17/18 fix checks PASS as-is. One issue found and fixed by testing agent: Fix#5's data-testid='room-continue-step1' was set on <ProButton> but ProButton (src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx line 238) was silently dropping the data-testid prop instead of forwarding it to the underlying <button>. After forwarding the prop, Fix#5 passes (button visible, enabled with empty name, advances the wizard to step 2 where open-rt60-modal-btn appears). Regression sweep of all 15 routes passes (each loads with sync-indicator + non-empty body; empty bodies during first bulk sweep were Cloudflare 429 rate-limit artifacts, not app bugs — confirmed by re-running with longer waits). Demo load, KPIs, gear inventory, and SPL toggle (no-crash) all verified. Two secondary issues discovered and reported for main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: Same double-slash testid bug as pre-fix nav-more — bottom nav pill testids come out as 'nav-pill-homegear-builder', 'nav-pill-homedsp', 'nav-pill-homelive', 'nav-pill-home' (concatenation of 'home' + path without separator, and the path leading '/' not stripped). Should be 'nav-pill-gear-builder', 'nav-pill-dsp', 'nav-pill-live', 'nav-pill-home' etc. Same file/pattern as Fix#2 in nav.tsx.

ui_bugs.component: Room Scan sticky Continuar vs FAB overlap
ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 420x900, the sticky full-width 'Continuar' ProButton (bbox x=16..404, y=830..878) visually sits underneath nav-fab-more (bbox x=182..238, y=827..883). Real user taps in the center-bottom area of the Continue button will land on the FAB and open 'Todos los módulos' bottom-sheet instead of advancing. Playwright force-clicks reproduce the issue; JS .click() bypasses it. Recommend either raising the Continue button above the FAB (extra bottom padding + z-index), moving the FAB slightly off-center, or converting the sticky bar to sit above the fab's visual line.

issues: sync-indicator icon (fixed top-3 right-3) is very close to the browser status bar / safe-area; on some Android mobile layouts it can overlap notch UI. Non-blocking, but consider explicit pt-safe/mt-safe wrapper — already added but confirm on real device.

action_items: Apply same fix as nav-more-* to BottomNav pills in src/components/soundmap/nav.tsx: use `nav-pill-${item.path === '/' ? 'home' : item.path.replace(/^\//,'').replace(/\//g,'-')}` (currently emits 'nav-pill-homegear-builder', 'nav-pill-homedsp', 'nav-pill-homelive').

Fix z-index/positioning conflict between sticky Continuar button on /room-scan step 1 and floating nav-fab-more — the FAB visually covers the middle of the Continue button on mobile 420x900. Add mb-16 / pb-16 to the sticky bar, or reposition FAB to right-3 corner.

Verify other pages using ProButton with data-testid (settings/index.tsx, export-page/index.tsx) now work correctly with the forwarded prop — my fix in ui.tsx enables previously-silently-dropped testids across the codebase.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx line 228-259: ProButton component was NOT forwarding data-testid (or any HTML button attributes) — silently dropping the prop meant every consumer that set data-testid on <ProButton> had no effect at runtime. Fixed by adding data-testid to the interface and passing it through. Consider extending to a spread of standard button HTML attributes (aria-*, form, name) for future-proofing.

src/components/soundmap/nav.tsx BottomNav pill map still has the SAME double-slash / missing-strip bug that was fixed for nav-more-*: bottom nav pill testids emit e.g. 'nav-pill-homegear-builder' because it concatenates 'home' with the raw path (leading '/' not stripped). Fix analogously.
src/pages/room-scan/index.tsx line 577: sticky 'Continuar' ProButton visually collides with the FAB on mobile. UX/testability concern — force clicks always hit the FAB.
SyncIndicator globally mounted in AppLayout (App.tsx line 53-57) works well; pt-safe is applied — confirmed sync-indicator resolves on every one of the 15 routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 iteration_1 fixes are now verified. Main agent should: (1) re-apply the strip-leading-slash pattern to nav-pill-* in BottomNav (same file src/components/soundmap/nav.tsx as Fix#2), (2) fix the FAB/Continuar overlap in /room-scan step 1. Testing infra note: Cloudflare rate-limits the preview URL — bulk-navigating 15 routes in <15 seconds triggers 429s that return an empty body. Use >=4-5s between goto() calls, and if body_len==0, wait 8s and reload. Also note that the pre-existing ProButton silent-drop-of-data-testid bug is now fixed in ui.tsx, so any prior tests that failed on ProButton data-testid selectors should be retried.
rca of the issue: Fix#5 (room-continue-step1) failed initially because the button is wrapped in <ProButton> (src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx). ProButton's interface did not declare data-testid and its render did not spread extra props onto the inner <button>, so the attribute was silently dropped. Confirmed by: (a) visually seeing an enabled 'Continuar' button on the /room-scan step 1 page with correct behavior, (b) grepping the source and finding data-testid='room-continue-step1' at line 577, and (c) inspecting ProButton to find no data-testid forwarding. Mitigation: added `"data-testid"?: string` to ProButtonProps and pass through to the DOM button. Re-tested — testid resolves, JS click advances to step 2 (open-rt60-modal-btn visible).
